summary: Guest sign-in succeeded and the admin identity persisted through a full extension Reload. The extension remained signed in without a selected organization; the visible no-organization toast accurately stated that the browser request was never sent. T05 remains partial because the UI did not expose the OAuth callback origin.
verification: T52: clicking Settings > Sign in while guest changed the extension to Email admin@admin.com, Role ADMIN, and a Sign out action; after extension Reload the same identity and role remained visible.
T05 runtime: sign-in from dev extension ID cihdmkcdjjckfhjpgoedmgfpoljebaml returned an authenticated state; that state survived extension Reload.
No organization was selected. The Organization setting displayed the explicit required picker; opening it showed 142 choices and Escape dismissed the list.
The exact no-organization toast text and observation timing limits are recorded in the run. No credentials or tokens were recorded.
limitations: The UI did not expose a provider auth page or chromiumapp callback origin, so T05 is not marked fully verified.
No organization was chosen, as directed; the authenticated session is therefore confirmed without an active organization.
